findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 lacks a test that drives `story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK` on a clean INIT story through a SUCCEEDING bootstrap and asserts that phase becomes INIT_CHECK and the worktree is created on disk. The recorded evidence maps this intent to `assertDevStartRecoversStuckInitCheckStory`, which calls `dev_start` on a story already stuck at INIT_CHECK — it exercises the new recovery command, not the `story_advance` success path. The atomicity fix defers phase persistence until after bootstrap succeeds; the only `story_advance INIT_CHECK` path exercised is the FAILURE case (edge intent). A regression in the success-path sequencing (e.g. phase accidentally written twice, or worktree not recorded on the story index after advance) would not be caught.
